verdict.rationale: With LOCALAI_AUTH=true, LocalAI documents per-user API keys and coarse admin/user roles, so an agent can get its own key with non-admin privileges. There is no evidence of finer scoping, such as limiting a key to specific models, endpoints or MCP tools, or of per-agent least-privilege controls. Missing for 10: per-key scopes/permissions (model, endpoint or tool restrictions), agent-specific credential issuance, key expiry/rotation docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
